name: @sohampatwardhan/claude-code-mcp-server
description: MCP server that lets AI agents (Muse, Grok, and other MCP clients) orchestrate Claude Code cloud sessions via the Claude Code CLI. Requires @anthropic-ai/claude-code installed and signed in (run `claude` once).
author: Soham Patwardhan
